messages.text: This tool allows you to invite new users to join as Community, Merchant, or Partner. They will receive a secure token valid for 48 hours. Choose the role you want to invite the new user as. Community, Merchant, or Partner. The available options depend on your own permissions.
If inviting a Community or Partner, enter the website URL they will manage.
Enter the email address of the person you want to invite. They will receive an invitation email with a secure link.
Enter the mobile number of the new user. This is used to send a PIN number, for verification.
Click Generate Token to send the invitation. The new user will receive an email with a secure link to join.
